name: MoNuSeg: Multi-Organ Nucleus Segmentation Benchmark
description: MoNuSeg is a foundational computational pathology benchmark for generalized nucleus boundary segmentation in digitized whole-slide images (WSIs). It contains 44 Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained tissue image patches of 1,000x1,000 pixels captured at 40x magnification across 7 organs (breast, liver, kidney, prostate, bladder, colon, stomach) from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). Approximately 21,623 individual nuclei boundaries were manually delineated by pathologists. The benchmark evaluates model generalizability across diverse organ types and staining variations under a 30-image training and 14-image testing partition.
